fact: GRAIN's comparative report on four West African countries says Benin was the first of the four to adopt a national AI strategy, in 2023.

A ministry representative on 16 July 2026 described the University of Abomey-Calavi's own AI strategy as in line with the national AI and big-data strategy (2023-2027), which is thereby shown as current; the university's own strategy is not the national one.
